data.text: I’m in for 15 tons today and will donate the full $15,000, provided John joins us and we hold the total to 60 tons with Luke catching zero. I grew up fishing this lake, and protecting our village means caring for both its fish and its people. I’ll also keep my catch to six tons next month under the shared recovery plan. Let’s send the donations directly to the clinic before 5 p.m. John, yours is the last commitment we need—are you in?
